usedFor: Evenium holds your events and guests and Razorpay collects payment when “New Guests Added” runs “Create Payment Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Guests Added” in Evenium, then “Create Payment Link” in Razorpay
bestTemplate.why: Each added guest gets a payment link with amount and expiry set, so nobody chases fees by hand.

watchOut: “Guest Created or Updated” also fires on edits, so one guest could get a second “Create Payment Link” run.
